name: showboard
description: Ask about your spreadsheets or database, and Claude answers with a board of charts, tables and notes in your browser. Read-only, and it runs on your computer.
long_description:
Showboard gives Claude a pen for your data. Point it at a folder of spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv), a SQLite file or a Postgres database, then ask a question such as "Show me revenue by month." Claude queries the data, read-only, and draws the answer as a board: headline numbers, line and bar charts, tables and notes, every figure from a query you can inspect. Boards open at http://localhost:4712 and are saved there, newest first.

Your data stays on your computer: Showboard only reads it, serves boards on localhost, and contacts no host but your own database. Spreadsheets reload when you save them, and messy ones are fine: title rows, Total rows, N/A and amounts typed as text are handled.

folder.title: Spreadsheet folder
folder.description: A folder of spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv). Each sheet becomes a table Claude can query. Showboard only reads them.

database.title: Database
database.description: Or a Postgres URL, such as postgres://reader:secret@localhost:5432/shop, or the full path of a SQLite file. Used instead of the folder. Give it a user that can only read.
